contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop and cafe windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The pebble is a scene prop, not a product. One gray shoe is held in the hand and the other is worn, and they are listed as one pair. The charcoal shorts and navy tights are separate products. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

deck.ko: 코랄 긴소매와 네이비 타이츠의 선명한 조합.

intro.ko: 한쪽 신발을 벗어 손에 들고 밑창 가까이의 작은 돌을 털어 냅니다.
intro.en: She removes one shoe and holds it while shaking out a small pebble.
intro.de: Sie zieht einen Schuh aus und hält ihn beim Ausschütteln eines kleinen Steins.

body.ko: 흰 반사선이 코랄 소매 바깥을 따라 내려갑니다. 차콜 쇼츠는 네이비 타이츠와 별도 층을 이루고 회색 양말 한쪽이 신발 밖으로 드러납니다. 검정 허리 파우치는 몸 앞에 붙어 두 손의 동작을 비워 줍니다. 회색 러닝화는 신은 한쪽과 손에 든 한쪽이 한 켤레를 이룹니다.
body.en: White reflective lines trace the outer coral sleeves. Charcoal shorts sit independently over navy tights, with one gray sock exposed outside the removed shoe. The black waist pouch stays close to the front and frees both hands. The shoe in hand and the one still worn form a complete gray running pair.
body.de: Weiße Reflexlinien folgen den äußeren korallfarbenen Ärmeln. Anthrazitshorts liegen getrennt über der Marinetight; eine graue Socke zeigt sich ohne Schuh. Die schwarze Hüfttasche bleibt vorne am Körper und lässt beide Hände frei. Gehaltener und getragener Schuh ergeben ein vollständiges graues Laufpaar.

pull.ko: 잠깐 멈추면 보이는 두 겹의 선.
pull.en: A brief stop reveals the layered lines.
pull.de: Eine kurze Pause zeigt getrennte Lagen.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A brief stop reveals the layered lines.

tip.ko: 안정된 곳에 멈춰 돌을 제거하고 양말 앞부분을 편 뒤 다시 신으세요.
tip.en: Stop on stable ground, remove the pebble and smooth the sock before putting the shoe back on.
tip.de: Auf festem Boden anhalten, den Stein entfernen und die Socke vor dem Anziehen glätten.

description.ko: 크루넥과 긴소매 바깥쪽 흰 반사선의 코랄 상의입니다.
description.en: Coral crewneck with white reflective lines along the outer sleeves.
description.de: Korallfarbenes Rundhalsshirt mit weißen Reflexlinien außen an den Ärmeln.

howToWear.ko: 소매 바깥 반사선이 비틀리지 않도록 커프를 정리하세요.
howToWear.en: Keep the outer sleeve lines straight by aligning the cuffs.
howToWear.de: Die Bündchen für gerade äußere Reflexlinien ausrichten.
